tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

# Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

# DeepSpeed Team

import math
import os
import types
from typing import Callable, Iterable, Union
from enum import Enum
import functools
import itertools
from typing import List
from collections import defaultdict
import logging
import torch
from torch import Tensor
from deepspeed import comm as dist
from torch.nn import Module
from torch.nn import Parameter

from .linear import zero3_linear_wrap

from deepspeed.utils import groups
import deepspeed
from ..utils import see_memory_usage, get_only_unique_item, view_as_uint8
from deepspeed.runtime.zero.config import DeepSpeedZeroConfig
from deepspeed.runtime.zero.utils import assert_ints_same_as_other_ranks, is_zero_param
from deepspeed.runtime.zero.offload_config import OffloadDeviceEnum
from deepspeed.runtime.config_utils import get_config_default
from deepspeed.utils import instrument_w_nvtx, logger
from deepspeed.comm.comm import init_distributed
from deepspeed.utils.debug import (debug_param2name_id_shape, debug_param2name_id_shape_device, debug_module2name,
                                   debug_param2name_id, debug_param2name_id_shape_status)
from deepspeed.accelerator import get_accelerator
from ..swap_tensor.partitioned_param_swapper import AsyncPartitionedParameterSwapper, PartitionedParamStatus
from deepspeed.inference.quantization.utils import _quantize_param, WEIGHT_QUANTIZATION_LAYERS, wrap_quantized_functional, wrap_load_from_state_dict
from deepspeed.runtime.torch_autocast import sort_dtypes, get_comm_dtype, has_comm_dtype
from deepspeed.runtime.keep_in_fp32 import KEEP_IN_FP32_AUTO, keep_in_fp32_pattern, keep_tensors_in_fp32

partitioned_param_data_shape = [0]
zero_init_context = 0
top_level_context = None
DS_Z3_EAGER_FALLBACK_OWNER_ATTR = "_ds_z3_eager_fallback_owner"
DS_Z3_GATHERED_PARAM_CONTEXT_DEPTH_ATTR = "_ds_z3_gathered_param_context_depth"


class DeepSpeedTensorOverride(Enum):
    dtype = 1
    device = 2


DEFAULT_TENSOR_OVERRIDES = [DeepSpeedTensorOverride.dtype, DeepSpeedTensorOverride.device]


def get_allgather_dtype(param, param_ds_tensor):
    autocast = has_comm_dtype(param)
    return get_comm_dtype(param) if autocast else param_ds_tensor.dtype


class NoGatherHandle:

    def __init__(self, param: Parameter) -> None:
        if param.ds_status != ZeroParamStatus.INFLIGHT:
            raise RuntimeError(f"expected param {param.ds_summary()} to be available")

        if hasattr(param.ds_tensor, "ds_quant_scale"):
            param.data = Init.quantizer_module.dequantize(param.ds_tensor.data,
                                                          param.ds_tensor.ds_quant_scale,
                                                          dtype=param.dtype).to(
                                                              device=get_accelerator().current_device_name(),
                                                              non_blocking=True).view(param.ds_shape)
        else:
            param.data = param.ds_tensor.data.to(device=get_accelerator().current_device_name(),
                                                 non_blocking=True).view(param.ds_shape)
        self.__param = param
        self.__complete = False

    def wait(self, **kwargs) -> None:
        if self.__complete:
            return

        if not get_accelerator().resolves_data_dependency():
            get_accelerator().current_stream().synchronize()
        self.__param.ds_status = ZeroParamStatus.AVAILABLE
        self.__complete = True


class NoGatherCoalescedHandle:

    def __init__(self, params: List[Parameter]) -> None:
        self.__params = params

# DeepSpeed Team
"""Keep the tensors a model names for fp32 in fp32 while the rest of the model trains in bf16 or fp16.

Hugging Face transformers models name these tensors in two class attributes:
``_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict`` (kept in fp32 under bf16 and fp16) and ``_keep_in_fp32_modules``
(kept in fp32 under fp16 only). transformers honors both when it loads a model by itself. Under ZeRO-3,
``zero.Init`` turns every floating tensor created in ``__init__`` into the training dtype, and
transformers' ZeRO-3 loader then copies the checkpoint into those tensors, so the lists were lost.

The main case is the MoE routing bias ``e_score_correction_bias`` (DeepSeek-V3, GLM-4.5, GLM-5 and others),
a buffer. In GLM-5.2 its values lie near 5 to 20 and differ from each other by less than 0.01, while bf16
values are 0.03 to 0.125 apart there, so bf16 leaves 3 to 16 distinct values for 256 experts and changes
which experts tokens are sent to.

``data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules`` selects the names:

* ``"auto"`` (default): the model's own transformers lists, if it has them.
* a list of patterns, matched the way transformers matches them: ``*`` stands for any characters,
  and a pattern may match anywhere in the full parameter or buffer name.
* ``[]``: keep nothing in fp32 (the behavior before this option existed).

Buffers are kept in fp32 in every configuration. Parameters are kept in fp32 only under ZeRO-3 without
parameter offload, the one optimizer that holds partitions of more than one dtype; DeepSeek-V4's
hyper-connection weights, attention sinks and norms, and gpt-oss's attention sinks, are examples.
"""

import re

import torch

from deepspeed.utils import logger

KEEP_IN_FP32_AUTO = "auto"


def keep_in_fp32_pattern(module, setting, dtype):
    """Compiled pattern for the tensor names of ``module`` to keep in fp32, or None when there are none.

    ``dtype`` is the training dtype. Under fp32 training nothing needs keeping.
    """
    if dtype not in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16):
        return None
    if setting is None or setting == KEEP_IN_FP32_AUTO:
        patterns = set()
        for module_name, child in module.named_modules():
            child_names = set(getattr(child, "_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict", None) or [])
            if dtype == torch.float16:
                child_names |= set(getattr(child, "_keep_in_fp32_modules", None) or [])
            for name in child_names:
                pattern = name.replace("*", ".*")
                if module_name:
                    pattern = rf"^{re.escape(module_name)}\..*{pattern}"
                patterns.add(pattern)
    else:
        patterns = {name.replace("*", ".*") for name in setting}
    if not patterns:
        return None
    # The same rule as transformers' core_model_loading.build_glob_alternation followed by re.search.
    return re.compile("|".join(sorted(patterns)))


def tensors_to_keep_in_fp32(module, pattern):
    """(full name, tensor, is_buffer) for every floating parameter and buffer whose full name matches."""
    matches = []
    for module_name, owner in module.named_modules():
        prefix = f"{module_name}." if module_name else ""
        for name, param in owner.named_parameters(recurse=False):
            if param.is_floating_point() and pattern.search(prefix + name):
                matches.append((prefix + name, param, False))
        for name, buf in owner.named_buffers(recurse=False):
            if buf is not None and buf.is_floating_point() and pattern.search(prefix + name):
                matches.append((prefix + name, buf, True))
    return matches


def _stored_dtype(tensor):
    # A ZeRO-3 parameter keeps its values in its partition; tensor.data is a placeholder.
    partition = getattr(tensor, "ds_tensor", None)
    return partition.dtype if partition is not None else tensor.dtype


def keep_tensors_in_fp32(module, pattern, include_params=True):
    """Convert the matching parameters and buffers of ``module`` to fp32 in place.

    A ZeRO-3 parameter is converted in its partition, so a later gather returns fp32 and a later
    checkpoint load writes exact fp32 values into it. A ZeRO-3 parameter stored quantized
    (zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights) stays quantized. With ``include_params=False`` only buffers
    are converted. Returns (parameters converted, buffers converted).
    """
    num_params, num_buffers = 0, 0
    for _, tensor, is_buffer in tensors_to_keep_in_fp32(module, pattern):
        if not is_buffer and not include_params:
            continue
        partition = getattr(tensor, "ds_tensor", None)
        if partition is not None and hasattr(partition, "ds_quant_scale"):
            # The partition holds int8 codes and their scales; converting the codes would not give the values.
            logger.warning_once("data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules: parameters stored quantized "
                                "(zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights) stay quantized")
            continue
        if _stored_dtype(tensor) == torch.float32:
            continue
        if partition is not None:
            partition.data = partition.data.float()
            # With hpZ, all-gathers read this node-local copy of the partition while it exists, and a later
            # checkpoint load writes into it. A quantized copy (frozen weights with quantized_nontrainable_weights)
            # stays as it is.
            secondary = getattr(tensor, "ds_secondary_tensor", None)
            if secondary is not None and not hasattr(secondary, "ds_quant_scale"):
                secondary.data = secondary.data.float()
        # For a ZeRO-3 parameter this converts the empty placeholder, or the full tensor when the
        # parameter is currently gathered, so the next gather and the next free keep fp32.
        tensor.data = tensor.data.float()
        if is_buffer:
            num_buffers += 1
        else:
            num_params += 1
    return num_params, num_buffers

        def _all_gather_dtype(params, world_size, rank_in_group, ds_process_group, allgather_dtype):
            comm_dtypes = [get_allgather_dtype(p, p.ds_tensor) for p in params]
            assert all(
                dtype == allgather_dtype
                for dtype in comm_dtypes), ("all params in a coalesced bucket must have the same communication dtype; "
                                            f"expected {allgather_dtype}, got {comm_dtypes}")

            partition_sz = sum(p.ds_tensor.ds_numel for p in params)

            use_secondary_tensor = params[0].ds_secondary_tensor is not None

            if use_secondary_tensor:
                partition_sz = sum(p.ds_tensor.ds_numel * p.ds_secondary_tensor_num_of_groups for p in params)

            flat_tensor = torch.empty(partition_sz * world_size,
                                      dtype=allgather_dtype,
                                      device=get_accelerator().current_device_name(),
                                      requires_grad=False)

            partitions: List[Parameter] = []
            for i in range(world_size):
                partitions.append(flat_tensor.narrow(0, partition_sz * i, partition_sz))

            if use_secondary_tensor:
                instrument_w_nvtx(torch.cat)([
                    p.ds_secondary_tensor.to(get_accelerator().current_device_name()).to(allgather_dtype)
                    for p in params
                ],
                                             out=partitions[rank_in_group])
            else:
                instrument_w_nvtx(torch.cat)(
                    [p.ds_tensor.to(get_accelerator().current_device_name()).to(allgather_dtype) for p in params],
                    out=partitions[rank_in_group])
            handle = _dist_allgather_fn(partitions[rank_in_group], flat_tensor, ds_process_group)
            #Fix get_partition_dp_group(params[0]))

            return AllGatherCoalescedHandle(
                allgather_handle=handle,
                params=params,
                partitions=partitions,
                world_size=world_size,
                use_secondary_tensor=use_secondary_tensor,
            )

        def _all_gather_sequential(params, world_size, use_secondary_tensor, ds_process_group, quantize):
            handles = []
            for param in params:
                buffer_size = math.ceil(param.ds_numel / world_size) * world_size
                if use_secondary_tensor:
                    buffer_size = param.ds_secondary_tensor.shape[0] * world_size  #make sure out is appropriately sized

                param_ds_tensor = param.ds_secondary_tensor if use_secondary_tensor else param.ds_tensor

                original_dtype = param_ds_tensor.dtype
                if quantize:
                    allgather_dtype = torch.int8
                else:
                    allgather_dtype = get_allgather_dtype(param, param_ds_tensor)

                param_buffer = torch.empty(
                    buffer_size,
                    dtype=allgather_dtype,
                    device=get_accelerator().current_device_name(),
                    requires_grad=False,
                )
                if not quantize:
                    handle = _dist_allgather_fn(
                        param_ds_tensor.to(get_accelerator().current_device_name()).to(allgather_dtype),
                        param_buffer,
                        ds_process_group,
                    )

                    if original_dtype == allgather_dtype:
                        param.data = param_buffer.narrow(0, 0, param.ds_numel).view(param.ds_shape).to(param.device)
                        handles.append(AllGatherHandle(handle, param))
                    else:
                        # This case is complicated:
                        # We use `register_post_accumulate_grad_hook` to set allgather hooks. Normally, the hook is
                        # called once per parameter, even if that parameter is tied to multiple layers.
                        # However, when the dtype changes, the hook may be triggered multiple times.
                        # If we directly do:
                        #   param_buffer.narrow(0, 0, param.ds_numel).view(param.ds_shape).to(param.device)
                        # as above, the dtype may differ, causing the gradient-reduce hook
                        # to be invoked multiple times.
                        # To avoid this, we leave `param.data` in a partitioned state.
                        # This prevents duplicate gradient-reduce hook calls.
                        # In theory, this path could be consolidated with the case where
                        # (original_dtype == allgather_dtype), but because it changes the
                        # state transition of DeepSpeed parameters, we keep it separate for safety.
                        handles.append(
                            AllGatherHandle(handle, param, param_buffer=param_buffer, original_dtype=original_dtype))
                else:
                    if hasattr(param_ds_tensor, "ds_quant_scale"):
                        scales = param_ds_tensor.ds_quant_scale
                        quantized_param = param_ds_tensor.data
                    else:
                        quantized_param, scales = self.quantizer_module.quantize(param_ds_tensor)
                    handle = _dist_allgather_fn(quantized_param.to(get_accelerator().current_device_name()),
                                                param_buffer, ds_process_group)

                    quant_scale_buffer = torch.empty(
                        scales.numel() * world_size,
                        dtype=scales.dtype,
                        device=get_accelerator().current_device_name(),
                        requires_grad=False,
                    )
                    quant_handle = _dist_allgather_fn(scales.to(get_accelerator().current_device_name()),
                                                      quant_scale_buffer, ds_process_group)
                    quant_info = QuantizationInfo()
                    quant_info.quantized_param = param_buffer.narrow(0, 0, param.ds_numel).view(param.ds_shape).to(
                        param.device)
                    quant_info.backend = self.quantizer_module
                    quant_info.quant_handle = quant_handle
                    quant_info.scale_buffer = quant_scale_buffer
                    handles.append(AllGatherHandle(handle, param, quantization=quant_info))
            return MultipleAllGatherHandles(handles)

def _partition(self, param_list, force=False, has_been_updated=False, free_data=True):
        for param in param_list:
            print_rank_0(f"Before Partitioning Param {param.ds_id}", force=False)
            if self.zero_param_process_group is not None:
                self._partition_param_sec(param, has_been_updated=has_been_updated)
            self._partition_param(param, has_been_updated=has_been_updated, free_data=free_data)

            param.ds_status = ZeroParamStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE

    @instrument_w_nvtx
    def _partition_param(self, param, buffer=None, has_been_updated=False, free_data=True):
        assert param.ds_status is not ZeroParamStatus.INFLIGHT, f" {param} Cannot partition a param in flight"
        global reuse_buffers
        print_rank_0(f"Param id {param.ds_id} status is {param.ds_status}", force=False)
        if param.ds_status is ZeroParamStatus.AVAILABLE:
            print_rank_0(f"Partitioning param id {param.ds_id} reuse buffers {reuse_buffers}", force=False)

            if param.ds_tensor is not None and not has_been_updated:  ##param already partitioned

                see_memory_usage(f'Before partitioning param {param.ds_id} {param.shape}', force=False)
                # param.data does not store anything meaningful in partitioned state
                if free_data:
                    free_param(param)
                see_memory_usage(f'After partitioning param {param.ds_id} {param.shape}', force=False)

                if param.ds_tensor.final_location == OffloadDeviceEnum.nvme:
                    print_rank_0(f"Param {param.ds_id} partition released since it exists in nvme", force=False)
                    param.nvme_swapper.remove_partition_and_release_buffers([param])
                    print_rank_0(
                        f"after swap Param {param.ds_id} {param.ds_tensor.shape} partition released since it exists in nvme",
                        force=False)

                return

            tensor_size = self._aligned_size(param)
            partition_size = tensor_size // self._partition_world_size(param)
            if param.ds_tensor is None:
                final_location = None
                if self.remote_device == OffloadDeviceEnum.nvme and self.param_swapper.swappable_tensor(
                        numel=partition_size):
                    final_location = OffloadDeviceEnum.nvme
                    buffer = self.param_swapper.get_buffer(param, partition_size)
                    partitioned_tensor = torch.empty(0, dtype=param.dtype, device=buffer.device)
                    partitioned_tensor.data = buffer.data
                    print_rank_0(f"ID {param.ds_id} Initializing partition for the first time for nvme offload.")

                else:
                    if param.ds_persist:
                        device = self.local_device
                    elif self.remote_device == OffloadDeviceEnum.nvme:
                        device = OffloadDeviceEnum.cpu
                    else:
                        device = self.remote_device

                    partitioned_tensor = torch.empty(partition_size, dtype=param.dtype, device=device)
                    # quantize the tensor if it's not trainable
                    if not param.requires_grad and self.quantized_nontrainable_weights:
                        partitioned_tensor, partitioned_tensor.ds_quant_scale = self.quantizer_module.quantize(
                            partitioned_tensor)

                    if device == OffloadDeviceEnum.cpu and self.pin_memory:
                        partitioned_tensor = get_accelerator().pin_memory(partitioned_tensor)

                partitioned_tensor.requires_grad = False
                param.ds_tensor = partitioned_tensor
                param.ds_tensor.ds_numel = partition_size
                param.ds_tensor.status = PartitionedParamStatus.AVAILABLE
                param.ds_tensor.final_location = final_location
                param.ds_numel_aligned = tensor_size

            start = partition_size * self._partition_rank(param)
            end = start + partition_size

            one_dim_param = param.contiguous().view(-1)

            if start < param.ds_numel and end <= param.ds_numel:
                src_tensor = one_dim_param.narrow(0, start, partition_size)

                with torch.no_grad():
                    # make sure param.ds_tensor requires_grad always be false,
                    # otherwise, torch tracer will complain.
                    param.ds_tensor.copy_(src_tensor)

292	def _backward_through_boundary(engine, batches):
293	    """Run the micro-batches of one optimizer step and stop after the last backward, before the update. Returns the
294	    fp32 reference for the accumulated gradient of `sink` there: the rest of ToyModelWithParams.forward redone in fp32
295	    from each forward's `linear` output and `sink` value, with the loss scaled as engine.backward scales it, summed in
296	    micro-batch order."""
297	    outputs, sinks = [], []
298	    hooks = [
299	        engine.module.register_forward_pre_hook(lambda module, inputs: sinks.append(module.sink.detach().clone())),
300	        engine.module.linear.register_forward_hook(lambda module, inputs, output: outputs.append(output.detach())),
301	    ]
302	    for i, x in enumerate(batches):
303	        engine.backward(engine(x))
304	        if i < len(batches) - 1:
305	            engine.step()
306	    for hook in hooks:
307	        hook.remove()
308	    expected = None
309	    for output, sink in zip(outputs, sinks):
310	        sink.requires_grad_(True)
311	        loss = ((output * sink + engine.module.router_bias)**2).mean()
312	        (loss / len(outputs)).backward()
313	        expected = sink.grad if expected is None else expected + sink.grad
314	    return expected

def external_parameters(self):
            return self._external_params.items()

        def all_parameters(self):
            return itertools.chain(self.named_parameters(self, recurse=False), external_parameters(self))

        module.ds_external_parameters = types.MethodType(external_parameters, module)
        module.all_parameters = types.MethodType(all_parameters, module)


def register_external_parameter(module, parameter):
    """Instruct DeepSpeed to coordinate ``parameter``'s collection and partitioning in
    the forward and backward passes of ``module``.

    This is used when a parameter is accessed outside of its owning module's
    ``forward()``. DeepSpeed must know to collect it from its partitioned
    state and when to release the memory.

    .. note::
        This is only applicable to training with ZeRO stage 3.

    Args:
        module (``torch.nn.Module``): The module that requires ``parameter`` in its forward pass.
        parameter (``torch.nn.Parameter``): The parameter to register.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: If ``parameter`` is not of type ``torch.nn.Parameter``.


    Examples
    ========

    #. Register a weight that is used in another module's forward pass (line 6).
       Parameter ``layer1.weight`` is used by ``layer2`` (line 11).

        .. code-block:: python
            :linenos:
            :emphasize-lines: 6,11

            class ModuleZ3(torch.nn.Module):
                def __init__(self, *args):
                    super().__init__(self, *args)
                    self.layer1 = SomeLayer()
                    self.layer2 = OtherLayer()
                    deepspeed.zero.register_external_parameter(self, self.layer1.weight)

                def forward(self, input):
                    x = self.layer1(input)
                    # self.layer1.weight is required by self.layer2.forward
                    y = self.layer2(x, self.layer1.weight)
                    return y
    """
    if not isinstance(parameter, torch.nn.Parameter):
        raise RuntimeError('Parameter is not a torch.nn.Parameter')

    if not hasattr(module, '_external_params'):
        _init_external_params(module)

    key = id(parameter)
    module._external_params[key] = parameter


def unregister_external_parameter(module, parameter):
    """Reverses the effects of :meth:`register_external_parameter`.

    Args:
        module (``torch.nn.Module``): The module to affect.
        parameter (``torch.nn.Parameter``): The parameter to unregister.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: If ``parameter`` is not of type ``torch.nn.Parameter``.
        RuntimeError: If ``parameter`` is not a registered external parameter of ``module``.
    """
    if not isinstance(parameter, torch.nn.Parameter):
        raise RuntimeError('Parameter is not a torch.nn.Parameter')

    if not hasattr(module, '_external_params') or id(parameter) not in module._external_params:
        raise RuntimeError('Parameter is not a registered external parameter of module.')

    key = id(parameter)
    del module._external_params[key]


class ZeroParamType(Enum):

    # same as regular pytorch parameters
    NORMAL = 1

    # parameters are partitioned across data parallel process
    PARTITIONED = 2

    # the parameter is held with a unique process rank
    # and is not available on all other process
    REMOTE = 3


class ZeroParamStatus(Enum):
    # parameters are fully present and ready for use on all processes
    AVAILABLE = 1

    # parameters are either partitioned or remote in some or all process
    NOT_AVAILABLE = 2

    # parameters are being gathered.
    INFLIGHT = 3


_orig_torch_tensor = torch.tensor
_orig_torch_empty = torch.empty

@instrument_w_nvtx
def free_param(param: Parameter) -> None:
    """Free underlying storage of a parameter."""
    if param.ds_active_sub_modules:
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot free a ZeRO-3 parameter while it is still active in submodules. "
                           "This can happen if: (1) submodules have not released the parameter, or "
                           "(2) you modified parameters inside a `GatheredParameters` context with "
                           "`modifier_rank=None`. For case (2), use `modifier_rank=<rank>` to broadcast "
                           "updates consistently across ranks. "
                           f"param={param.ds_summary()}")
    if get_accelerator().on_accelerator(param.data):
        # need to make sure that we don't free the parameter while it is still
        # being used for computation
        if not get_accelerator().is_synchronized_device():
            param.data.record_stream(get_accelerator().current_stream())
    # param.data doesn't store anything meaningful in partitioned state
    param.data = torch.empty(0, dtype=param.dtype, device=param.device)
    param.ds_status = ZeroParamStatus.NOT_AVAILABLE

temp_contiguous_tensor = None
empty_buffers = {}

class GatheredParameters:

    def __init__(self, params, modifier_rank=None, fwd_module=None, enabled=True):
        """A context that collects parameters that were partitioned via a
        :class:`deepspeed.zero.Init` context. The parameters are partitioned
        again upon exit.

        Args:
            params (``torch.nn.Parameter``): A single parameter, or an iterable of parameters (list, tuple, generator) of parameters to collect.
                It's assumed that all parameters are zero params.
            modifier_rank (int, optional): If specified, this rank's parameter will be
                broadcasted on exit from the context. This argument is required if ``params`` are
                modified, so that all processes have a consistent view of the data. Defaults
                to ``None``.
            fwd_module (``torch.nn.Module``, optional): If specified, ``params`` will be
                registered as external parameters of ``fwd_module``. See :meth:`deepspeed.zero.register_external_parameter`.
            enabled (bool, optional): If ``False``, this context is a no-op. Defaults to ``True``.

        Important: Make sure to use ``modifier_rank`` that is not ``None`` (e.g., ``modifier_rank=0``)
        if you need the GPU memory allocated by gather to be released upon exit from the context manager.

        Important: if ``params`` isn't an iterable of parameters or a single parameter it'll be silently ignored!

        Examples
        ========

        #. Allocate a partitioned module, initialize its weight on rank 0, and update all
           processes.

            .. code-block:: python

                with deepspeed.zero.Init():
                    linear = torch.nn.Linear(1000,1000)

                with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters(linear.weight,
                                                       modifier_rank=0):
                    if deepspeed.comm.get_rank() == 0:
                        linear.weight.zero_()

                with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters(linear.weight,
                                                       modifier_rank=0):
                    if deepspeed.comm.get_rank() == 0:
                        linear.weight.zero_()

        #. Collect a partitioned weight to pass to another module during
           training. The parameter will be registered as an external parameter
           and made available during the backward pass.

            .. code-block:: python
                :emphasize-lines: 6

                def forward(self, input):
                    x = self.layer1(input)

                    # self.layer1.weight is required by self.layer2.forward
                    with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters(self.layer1.weight,
                                                           fwd_module=self):
                        y = self.layer2(x, self.layer1.weight)
                    return y


        #. Pretrained model loading

            .. code-block:: python

                with deepspeed.zero.Init():
                    model = MyModel()

                state_dict = torch.load(model_path, map_location="cpu")

                def load(module: nn.Module, prefix=""):
                    # because zero3 puts placeholders in model params, this context
                    # manager gathers (unpartitions) the params of the current layer, then loads from
                    # the state dict and then re-partitions them again
                    with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters(list(module.parameters(recurse=False)), modifier_rank=0):

#Process group for secondary partition all (group) gather
        param.ds_zero_param_process_group = self.zero_param_process_group
        param.ds_secondary_tensor_group_size = self.num_ranks_in_param_group
        param.ds_secondary_tensor_num_of_groups = self.num_param_groups

        # This is set to the Async Param swapper if remote device is nvme
        # else this is set to None
        param.nvme_swapper = self.param_swapper

        # DeepSpeed Param ID
        param.ds_id = Init.param_id
        Init.param_id += 1

        def all_gather(param_list=None, async_op=False, hierarchy=0):
            cls = param
            if param_list is None:
                param_list = [cls]
            return self._all_gather(param_list, async_op=async_op, hierarchy=hierarchy)

        def _all_gather_dtype(params, world_size, rank_in_group, ds_process_group, allgather_dtype):
            comm_dtypes = [get_allgather_dtype(p, p.ds_tensor) for p in params]
            assert all(
                dtype == allgather_dtype
                for dtype in comm_dtypes), ("all params in a coalesced bucket must have the same communication dtype; "
                                            f"expected {allgather_dtype}, got {comm_dtypes}")

            partition_sz = sum(p.ds_tensor.ds_numel for p in params)

            use_secondary_tensor = params[0].ds_secondary_tensor is not None

            if use_secondary_tensor:
                partition_sz = sum(p.ds_tensor.ds_numel * p.ds_secondary_tensor_num_of_groups for p in params)

            flat_tensor = torch.empty(partition_sz * world_size,
                                      dtype=allgather_dtype,
                                      device=get_accelerator().current_device_name(),
                                      requires_grad=False)

            partitions: List[Parameter] = []
            for i in range(world_size):
                partitions.append(flat_tensor.narrow(0, partition_sz * i, partition_sz))

            if use_secondary_tensor:
                instrument_w_nvtx(torch.cat)([
                    p.ds_secondary_tensor.to(get_accelerator().current_device_name()).to(allgather_dtype)

# zero.Init：参数从出生就切分

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 解释 `deepspeed.zero.Init` 上下文管理器如何在模型**构建期**（而不是训练开始后）就把每个参数切分到多个进程上，以及为什么这能突破「单卡必须先装下完整 fp32 模型」的显存墙。
2. 手算一个参数在给定 world size 下如何 padding、对齐、分桶：每个 rank 分到哪一段、为什么总分区量略大于参数量。
3. 区分取回参数的几种句柄：`AllGatherHandle`、`AllGatherCoalescedHandle`、`AllReduceCoalescedHandle`、`NoGatherHandle` 与 `MultipleAllGatherHandles`，并说出 #8843 之后「多 dtype 分区按 dtype 拆分」的新规则。
4. 说明 `register_external_parameter` 解决什么问题：不在宿主模块 `forward()` 里使用的权重，靠谁来触发 gather 与释放。
5. 解读本周期 #8843 给 `zero.Init` 增加的收尾钩子 `_keep_in_fp32`：transformers 模型点名的 fp32 参数/缓冲如何在**分区上**就地转回 fp32，量化分区为何保持量化，参数卸载时为何只保 buffers。

本讲是 ZeRO 单元（u5）的第二篇，承接 u5-l1 的三阶段显存公式，把 stage 3 的「参数切分」从概念落到源码。

## 2. 前置知识

- **ZeRO-3 参数切分（u5-l1）**：混合精度 + Adam 下每卡模型状态约 \(16\Psi\) 字节，stage 3 把参数本身也按数据并行度切分，每卡只留 \(1/N_d\)。本讲解释这个切分发生在什么时刻、按什么规则。
- **torch.nn.Module 的构造协议**：PyTorch 模型是嵌套的 `nn.Module`，每个子模块在自己的 `__init__` 里创建 `nn.Parameter`。`zero.Init` 的核心技巧就是在「每个子模块 `__init__` 刚结束」这个时刻插一脚。
- **上下文管理器**：`with ... :` 语法进入 `__enter__`、离开 `__exit__`。`zero.Init()` 本身是一个可以 `with` 的对象。
- **分布式进程组（u3-l2/u3-l3）**：`dist.get_rank()`、`dist.get_world_size()`、all-gather/all-reduce 等集合通信的原语语义；`deepspeed.comm` 是对 torch.distributed 的统一包装。
- **bf16 的分辨率问题（u4-l3）**：bf16 只有 8 位尾数，数值 8.0 附近的相邻可表示值相差 0.0625；某些张量（如 MoE 路由 bias `e_score_correction_bias`）的取值在 bf16 下会塌缩成同一个值，这是 #8843 整套 keep_in_fp32 机制的动机。
- **检查点加载时机**：transformers 的 `from_pretrained` 在模型 `__init__` 跑完之后才把权重拷进去；这个顺序是理解「收尾钩子为什么放在 `_post_init_method` 末尾」的关键。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py) | 本讲主角：`Init` 上下文、参数的 `partition`/`all_gather` 集合方法、各取回句柄、`register_external_parameter`、`GatheredParameters` |
| [deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py) | keep_in_fp32 的模式匹配与就地转换（#8843 后参数与缓冲统一处理） |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 Init 上下文管理器：给 nn.Module 注入「出生即切分」钩子

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

普通方式训练 ZeRO-3 有一个隐藏前提：模型必须**先被完整构造出来**（每卡一份完整的 fp32 参数），然后引擎才能把它切分。对一个万亿参数模型，fp32 权重是 4TB——每张卡、每个进程都要先在 CPU 内存里装下这 4TB，构造完成才能释放。这堵墙与训练时的稳态显存无关，纯粹是「出生时刻」的瞬时峰值。

`zero.Init` 的解法是把切分时机提前到构造期：在每个 `nn.Module.__init__` 结束的瞬间，立刻把它刚创建的参数切分、丢掉全量副本。这样任意时刻每张卡最多只持有「正在构造的那一层」的全量参数，构造完成即释放。官方 docstring 用万亿参数模型算了这笔账：8 卡节点本来需要 32TB CPU 内存（数据并行冗余），切分后无论多少卡都只需要原样的 4TB。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
with deepspeed.zero.Init():
    model = MyLargeModel()
    │
    ├─ __enter__: patch torch.nn.Module.__init__（在每个子模块 __init__ 末尾追加 _post_init_method）
    │             zero_init_context 深度计数 +1（支持嵌套 with）
    │
    ├─ MyLargeModel() 内部：每个子模块 __init__ 结束时触发 _post_init_method(module)
    │    ├─ 遍历 module.named_parameters(recurse=False)（只看本模块直属参数）
    │    ├─ param 搬到本卡 → 广播对齐各 rank 的初始值 → param.partition() 切分
    │    └─ self._keep_in_fp32(module)   ← #8843 新增收尾钩子（见 4.5）
    │
    └─ __exit__: 恢复被 patch 的 __init__，打印参数统计
```

要点：子模块是**从内向外**逐层构造的——`Linear` 先于 `TransformerLayer`、`TransformerLayer` 先于整个 model——所以 `_post_init_method` 会在每层构造完的瞬间就切掉它，父模块后续对这些权重的修改则由包装过的 `Module.apply` 走「先 gather 再改再 partition」的路径保证不丢失。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

基类 `InsertPostInitMethodToModuleSubClasses` 负责进出上下文时安装/卸载补丁，用模块级计数器 `zero_init_context` 支持嵌套，并在顶层上下文退出时打印参数统计：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L353-L386](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L353-L386)：`__enter__` 里只有 `zero_init_context == 0`（最外层）才真正 `patch_init_and_builtins()`；`__exit__` 把计数减一，归零时卸载补丁并让 rank 0 打印 `finished initializing model - num_params = ...`。

`Init` 类继承它，构造函数先解析配置并读取 keep_in_fp32 设置：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L946-L953](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L946-L953)：`class Init(InsertPostInitMethodToModuleSubClasses)`，类属性里还有 `param_persistence_threshold` 等持久化阈值（见 4.2）。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1079-L1083](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1079-L1083)：从 `DeepSpeedConfig` 读出 `keep_in_fp32_modules`（`data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules`，默认 `"auto"`）；若未初始化分布式则顺带 `init_distributed()`。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1131-L1135](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1131-L1135)：`local_device` 由 `LOCAL_RANK` 环境变量决定。注意：**当前版本没有 `gpu_id` 参数**（旧版教程里的 `gpu_id` 已移除），设备选择完全走 `LOCAL_RANK`。

`_post_init_method` 是整个机制的心脏：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1227-L1248](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1227-L1248)：遍历**直属**参数（`recurse=False`，因为子模块早已各自处理过），跳过已是 zero param 的；不在加速器上的先搬到本卡；名字为 `weight` 且配置了量化初始化的先量化；然后 `_zero_init_param` 完成切分。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1195-L1202](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1195-L1202)：`_zero_init_param` 三步——转成 deepspeed 参数（挂上 `ds_tensor` 等属性）、在分区组内从 rank 0 **广播**初始值（否则各 rank 各自随机初始化，切出的分片拼起来就不是同一个模型）、最后 `param.partition()`。

除了 `with` 语法，`Init` 还提供「事后切分」入口，用于已经构造好的 CPU 模型：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1173-L1177](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1173-L1177)：传入 `module=` 时走 `_convert_to_zero_parameters`（注意这条路没有广播步骤，要求各 rank 模型一致），随后同样调用 `_keep_in_fp32(module)`——两个入口共享收尾钩子。

`free_param` 解释了「切分后参数本体去哪了」——`param.data` 被替换成一个 0 元素占位张量，真实数据只在 `ds_tensor` 分区里：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L308-L325](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L308-L325)：`param.data = torch.empty(0, dtype=param.dtype, device=param.device)`，状态置为 `NOT_AVAILABLE`。这就是为什么 ZeRO-3 下直接读 `param.data` 会得到空张量、必须经 `GatheredParameters` 或 hook 触发的 all-gather 取回。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：亲眼确认「参数出生即切分」——构造完的模型里，`param.data` 是 0 元素占位符，真实数据躺在 `param.ds_tensor` 里。

**操作步骤**（单进程即可，CPU 环境可跑）：

```python
# practice_zero_init_basic.py（示例代码）
import torch
import deepspeed

with deepspeed.zero.Init(dtype=torch.bfloat16):
    linear = torch.nn.Linear(1000, 1000)

w = linear.weight
print("ds_status:", w.ds_status)          # NOT_AVAILABLE：已切分、未取回
print("data.shape:", w.data.shape)        # torch.Size([0])：占位符
print("ds_tensor:", w.ds_tensor)          # 本 rank 持有的分区
print("ds_numel:", w.ds_numel)            # 原始元素数 1000000
print("ds_numel_aligned:", w.ds_numel_aligned)
print("partition numel:", w.ds_tensor.ds_numel)
```

运行：`torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 practice_zero_init_basic.py`（若缺 GPU 用 `deepspeed --num_cpus 1` 或设置 DS_ACCELERATOR=cpu，待本地验证）。

**需要观察的现象**：`data.shape` 为 `[0]`；`ds_tensor.ds_numel` 等于 `ds_numel_aligned`（world_size=1 时二者都等于 1000000，padding 为 0）。

**预期结果**：world_size=1 时一切数值都相等——这恰好说明单进程下切分是「恒等」的，也解释了 4.3 的 NoGather 优化为什么存在。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `_post_init_method` 里遍历参数用 `recurse=False`？

**答案**：子模块构造完成时它的参数已被切分并挂上 `ds_tensor`（变成 zero param），父模块的 `_post_init_method` 只需处理自己新建的直属参数；递归遍历只会重复处理已切分参数（代码里也用 `is_zero_param(param)` 跳过，但 `recurse=False` 从根上避免了）。

**练习 2**：`_zero_init_param` 为什么在 partition 之前先 broadcast？

**答案**：`nn.Linear` 等层的默认初始化是随机采样，各进程种子不同则各 rank 拿到的「完整模型」不同；先在分区组内从 rank 0 广播，保证所有 rank 从同一份初值切分，切出来的分片才能拼回同一个模型。

**练习 3**：`with zero.Init():` 里再嵌套一层 `with zero.Init():` 会重复 patch 吗？

**答案**：不会。`zero_init_context` 计数器保证只有最外层（计数从 0 变 1）执行 `patch_init_and_builtins`，内层只加计数；退出时计数归零才卸载，见 [partition_parameters.py:L353-L376](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L353-L376)。

### 4.2 partition：对齐、分桶与就地切分

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

「把参数切给 W 个 rank」需要先回答一个除法问题：\(N\) 个元素分给 \(W\) 份，除不尽怎么办？答案是 padding：补零凑成 \(W\) 的倍数，再等分。同时，并非所有参数都值得切分——小于阈值的参数（比如 norm 的 scale/bias）保持复制（persist）反而省通信。

需要澄清一个历史名词：旧版 DeepSpeed 教材里的 `max_num_params`（限制单次 all-gather 的参数量）在当前代码中已不存在；与之配套的 bucket 控制现在由 stage3 优化器侧的 `stage3_prefetch_bucket_size`、`reduce_bucket_size` 等配置承担（见 [zero/config.py:L113-L255](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/config.py#L113-L255)，详解在 u5-l6）。`Init` 层面的切分只由 world size 和持久化阈值决定。另外注意：配置项 `parameter_alignment`（[zero/config.py:L327](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/config.py#L327)）属于 ZeRO-1/2 的扁平缓冲对齐（stage_1_and_2.py），与本讲的按 world size 对齐是两回事。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

设参数元素数为 \(N\)（`ds_numel`），分区组大小为 \(W\)，则：

\[
P = (W - N \bmod W) \bmod W \quad\text{（padding）}
\]

\[
A = N + P \quad\text{（aligned\_size）}, \qquad S = \frac{A}{W} \quad\text{（每 rank 分区大小）}
\]

rank \(r\) 负责原参数展平后的区间 \([rS,\ (r+1)S)\)，区间尾巴越过 \(N\) 的部分不拷贝（保持新分配的空值）。因此**所有 rank 的分区拼起来是 \(A\) 个元素 ≥ \(N\)**，多出来的就是 padding。

流程伪代码：

```text
partition(param):
    若 ds_tensor 已存在且未被更新 → 只释放 param.data（重复 partition 幂等）
    A = ds_numel + padding_size
    S = A // world_size
    分配 partitioned_tensor（remote_device 上，S 个元素，dtype=param.dtype）
      ├─ ds_persist 且很小 → 留在本卡
      ├─ remote_device=nvme → 从 swapper 拿缓冲
      ├─ 不可训练且开 zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights → 存 int8 码 + ds_quant_scale
      └─ cpu 且 pin_memory → 锁页
    把 one_dim_param 的 [rS, min((r+1)S, N)) 拷进本 rank 分区
    free_param(param)  # param.data 变 0 元素占位符
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1701-L1710](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1701-L1710)：对齐三件套 `_aligned_size` / `_padding_size` / `_partition_numel`，就是上面两个公式的直译。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1785-L1844](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1785-L1844)：`_partition_param` 的分配段——`tensor_size = self._aligned_size(param)`、`partition_size = tensor_size // self._partition_world_size(param)`；随后按 remote_device/persist/量化三种情况分配分区张量，并记录 `ds_numel_aligned`。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1846-L1873](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1846-L1873)：拷贝段——`start = partition_size * rank`；完整落在参数内则整段 `copy_`，跨界（最后一个有效 rank）则只 `narrow` 拷有效元素；最后 `free_param` 释放全量副本。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1776-L1783](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1776-L1783)：`_partition` 对外入口；hpZ（`zero_hpz_partition_size > 1`）时还会额外切一份节点内二级分区 `_partition_param_sec`。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1296-L1301](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1296-L1301)：持久化判定——`param.ds_numel <= param_persistence_threshold` 且累计元素不超过 `model_persistence_threshold` 时 `ds_persist = True`，小参数全程复制、免通信。两个阈值的配置别名是 `stage3_param_persistence_threshold`（[zero/config.py:L238](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/config.py#L238)）。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：用手算公式预测 `ds_tensor.ds_numel`，再与程序输出对账。

**操作步骤**（示例代码，两进程观察 padding）：

```python
# practice_partition_math.py（示例代码）
import torch
import deepspeed

with deepspeed.zero.Init(dtype=torch.bfloat16):
    m = torch.nn.Linear(7, 5)   # 35 个元素 + bias 5 个 = 两个参数

for name, p in m.named_parameters():
    W = deepspeed.comm.get_world_size()
    pad = (W - p.ds_numel % W) % W
    print(f"{name}: ds_numel={p.ds_numel} world={W} "
          f"aligned={p.ds_numel_aligned} expected={p.ds_numel + pad} "
          f"partition={p.ds_tensor.ds_numel} expected={p.ds_numel // W + (1 if pad or True else 0)}")
```

运行：`torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 practice_partition_math.py`。

**需要观察的现象**：`weight`（35 元素）在 W=2 下 padding=1，aligned=36，每 rank 分区 18；`bias`（5 元素）padding=1，aligned=6，分区 3。rank 1 的 weight 分区只有前 17 个元素是有效值、第 18 个是 padding。

**预期结果**：`ds_numel_aligned == ds_numel + pad`、`ds_tensor.ds_numel == aligned // W` 在每个参数上都成立；两 rank 分区数之和 = aligned ≥ ds_numel。（具体打印值待本地验证。）

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：N=1000、W=3，padding、aligned、每 rank 分区各是多少？哪个 rank 的分区里有 padding 元素？

**答案**：\(1000 \bmod 3 = 1\)，\(P = 2\)，\(A = 1002\)，\(S = 334\)。rank 2 的区间是 [668, 1002)，其中 [1000, 1002) 两个元素是 padding（代码里 start < ds_numel 才拷贝，rank 2 只拷 668~999 共 332 个有效元素，分区尾部两个保持未写）。

**练习 2**：为什么每个 rank 的分区大小必须相等（而不是「最后一人拿零头」）？

**答案**：取回路径依赖 all-gather：各 rank 出一份等长分区、拼成一块平坦大缓冲，再从中 narrow 出每个参数的完整形状（见 4.3）。等长分区让 all-gather 的输出布局在各 rank 上一致、可预测；不等长则每个参数在缓冲中的偏移因 rank 而异，无法一次通信取回。

**练习 3**：`stage3_param_persistence_threshold` 设成很大的值会发生什么？

**答案**：几乎所有参数 `ds_persist=True`，`_partition_param` 分配分区时 `device = self.local_device`（留在本卡不卸载）， ZeRO-3 退化为「参数常驻 + 仍然走 hook 式生命周期管理」，省了通信但失去切分的显存收益——这正是 keep_in_fp32 测试里把它设为 0 的反例：测试要强制**每个**参数都真正切分（[test_keep_in_fp32_modules.py:L246-L248](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/tests/unit/v1/half_precision/test_keep_in_fp32_modules.py#L246-L248)）。

### 4.3 取回参数：allgather 句柄家族与 NoGather 优化

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

切分只是硬币的一面；forward/backward 每用到一层，都要把这层参数的 W 份分区拼回完整张量。DeepSpeed 把「发起通信 + 稍后取结果」封装成**句柄（handle）**对象，`wait()` 里做真正的拼接。句柄家族有五名成员：

| 句柄 | 触发条件 | 通信方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NoGatherHandle` / `NoGatherCoalescedHandle` | 分区组 world_size == 1 | 无通信，直接 view 回来 |
| `AllGatherHandle` | 顺序（逐参数）取回 | 一次 all_gather |
| `AllGatherCoalescedHandle` | 多参数合并取回（默认） | 一次 all_gather + 本地拼接 |
| `AllReduceCoalescedHandle` | 配置 `stage3_use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params=true` | 一次 all_reduce（每 rank 写自己那段再求和） |
| `MultipleAllGatherHandles` | 以上任一情况的「多份打包」 | 依次 wait |

参数状态机贯穿始终：`NOT_AVAILABLE`（已切分）→ `INFLIGHT`（通信中）→ `AVAILABLE`（可用），`free_param` 再把它打回 `NOT_AVAILABLE`。

**all_reduce 为什么能替代 all_gather**：all_reduce 让每个 rank 都拿到「所有 rank 输入之和」。每个 rank 先把一块全零平坦缓冲中**自己负责的那段**写成自己的分区，其余段保持零，求和后每个 rank 的缓冲都等于「按 rank 顺序拼接的完整参数」——与 all_gather 的结果相同，但通信量从 \(W \times S\) 降为约 \(2 \times S\)（W 较大时）。代价是它要求**同一桶内所有参数同 dtype**（一块平坦缓冲只能一种 dtype）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`all_gather_coalesced(params)` 的分发逻辑：

```text
params 按 ds_id 排序                     # 各 rank 顺序必须一致，否则通信错位/死锁
├─ 空列表 → NoGatherCoalesced
├─ 分区组 world_size == 1 → NoGatherCoalesced
├─ use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params 且非量化且非 hpZ:
│    ├─ 分区 dtype 不止一种（#8843: fp32 kept 参数 + bf16 参数混桶）
│    │    → 按 dtype 拆桶，每 dtype 递归一次 → MultipleAllGatherHandles
│    └─ 单 dtype → 一块平坦缓冲一次 all_reduce → AllReduceCoalescedHandle
└─ 常规 all-gather 路径:
     按「通信 dtype」分桶（autocast 感知）→ 每桶一块 flat_tensor
     各 rank 把自己分区 cat 进 flat_tensor 的本 rank 段 → all_gather
     → AllGatherCoalescedHandle.wait(): 从 flat_tensor 逐参数 narrow + cat + view(ds_shape)
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：验证「切分 → 取回」往返无损，并体会 `GatheredParameters` 的用法。

**操作步骤**（示例代码）：

```python
# practice_gather_roundtrip.py（示例代码）
import torch
import deepspeed

# 先在 Init 外构造并保存一份初值，再用 module= 入口切分
torch.manual_seed(0)
m = torch.nn.Linear(64, 64, bias=False)
saved = m.weight.detach().clone()

deepspeed.zero.Init(module=m, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
print("after Init:", m.weight.data.shape)          # [0]：已切分

with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters([m.weight], modifier_rank=0):
    print("gathered:", m.weight.data.shape)        # [64, 64]
    diff = (m.weight.data.float() - saved.float()).abs().max()
    print("max diff vs saved:", diff.item())

# 退出上下文后参数应再次回到分区态
print("after exit:", m.weight.data.shape)          # 预期 [0]
```

运行：`torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 practice_gather_roundtrip.py`。

**需要观察的现象**：Init 后 `data.shape=[0]`；GatheredParameters 内恢复 `[64, 64]`；退出后回到 `[0]`；diff 为 0（world_size=1 无通信、无 dtype 变化时精确往返）。

**预期结果**：单进程下 `max diff = 0.0`。换成 2 进程 + bf16 时，若保存的初值是 fp32，往返会引入 bf16 舍入（Init 的 dtype 转换发生在切分前），diff 不再为 0——这个对比正好演示 4.5 要解决的「精度丢失」问题。（具体数值待本地验证。）

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`all_gather_coalesced` 为什么必须先 `sorted(params, key=lambda p: p.ds_id)`，哪怕调用方传进来的是同一个 set？

**答案**：合并 all-gather 把参数列表展平成一块缓冲、一次通信完成，要求每个 rank 按**相同顺序**排列参数；Python set 的迭代顺序因进程而异（受哈希种子影响），不排序会导致各 rank 的缓冲布局不一致，静默取错值；分组路径下不同顺序还会让各 rank 以不同顺序发起集合通信造成死锁（源码注释 [L1556-L1562](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1556-L1562)）。

**练习 2**：#8843 之前，一个 keep_in_fp32 的 fp32 参数与 bf16 参数混进同一个 all-reduce 桶会发生什么？

**答案**：all-reduce 路径用 `get_only_unique_item(p.ds_tensor.dtype for p in params)` 决定整块平坦缓冲的 dtype——桶内出现两种 dtype 会破坏「唯一」假设（旧代码在此处会直接失败或被迫统一 dtype，fp32 分区被舍入到 bf16 就抵消了保留意义）。#8843 在入口先按 dtype 拆桶，每 dtype 一块缓冲一次 all_reduce，语义变为「每种 dtype 独立、精确」。

**练习 3**：`NoGatherHandle` 存在的意义是什么？它省掉了什么？

**答案**：分区组 world_size=1（单卡训练、或子组划分后某参数只在组内切分）时 all_gather 是恒等操作，通信是纯开销；NoGather 跳过通信，直接把本 rank 的分区 `view` 回 `param.data`。它省掉的是一次「把自己那份数据发给自己」的集体通信调用及其框架开销。

### 4.4 register_external_parameter：不在 forward 里用的权重靠谁取回

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

ZeRO-3 的按需取回靠 **module hook**：参数的宿主模块执行 `forward` 前 hook 触发 gather、执行后释放。但有些权重不在宿主模块的 `forward()` 里被使用——典型例子是「模块 A 的权重被模块 B 直接按张量读取」。这种参数没有 hook 能挂，forward 时它会一直是 0 元素占位符，静默算出错误结果。

`register_external_parameter(module, parameter)` 把参数登记到 `module._external_params`（按 `id(parameter)` 索引），等于告诉 DeepSpeed：「在 `module` 的 forward/backward 期间，请替我收集并释放这个参数」。参数协调器（u5-l5 详解）在扫描模块依赖时会把这些外部参数一并纳入 gather/release 计划。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
register_external_parameter(module, P)
  ├─ 校验 P 是 nn.Parameter
  ├─ module 无 _external_params 则初始化登记表
  └─ module._external_params[id(P)] = P

运行期（parameter_offload 协调器）：
  扫描某模块的 forward 依赖 = 直属参数 + module.ds_external_parameters()
  → gather 一起取回 / backward 后一起释放
```

### 4.5 收尾钩子：keep_in_fp32 就地转换（#8843 本周期核心变更）

#### 4.5.1 概念说明

`zero.Init` 会把构造期创建的**所有浮点张量**转成训练 dtype（bf16/fp16）。但 transformers 模型会点名某些张量必须留在 fp32——类属性 `_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict`（bf16/fp16 下都保）与 `_keep_in_fp32_modules`（仅 fp16 下保）。典型如 DeepSeek 系的 MoE 路由 bias `e_score_correction_bias`：GLM-5.2 中它的取值在 5~20 之间、彼此相差不到 0.01，而 bf16 在该区间的可表示值间隔是 0.03~0.125——转成 bf16 后 256 个专家的 bias 塌缩成 3~16 个不同值，**直接改变 token 被路由到哪个专家**。

问题在于时机：`zero.Init` 在 `__init__` 里就完成了 dtype 转换，而 transformers 的检查点加载发生在**之后**——列表信息在转换那一刻已经丢了。#8843 的解法是给 `Init` 加一个**收尾钩子**：每个模块的 `_post_init_method` 末尾调用 `_keep_in_fp32(module)`，把点名参数/缓冲**就地**转回 fp32。

四个关键设计：

1. **时机**：transformers 模型自身 `__init__` 跑完的瞬间——它的 fp32 列表此刻是完整的（嵌套子模块的列表也能通过 `named_modules()` 收集到）、它的子模块参数已经分区（转换发生在**分区上**）、而任何检查点还没加载（之后的加载会写入精确 fp32 值）。
2. **就地转换分区**：ZeRO-3 参数的本体是 `ds_tensor` 分区，`keep_tensors_in_fp32` 直接 `partition.data = partition.data.float()`——此后 gather 返回 fp32、检查点加载写入的 fp32 值精确存活。hpZ 的 `ds_secondary_tensor`（节点内二级副本）同步转换。
3. **量化分区保持量化**：`zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights` 把冻结权重存成 int8 码 + 缩放因子；把 int8 码转成 fp32 得到的是乱码而不是原值，因此跳过并告警。
4. **参数卸载只保 buffers**：`remote_device` 非 `none`（分区躺在 CPU/NVMe 上的单一 dtype 平坦缓冲）时，分区没有独立的 dtype 可言，参数退回训练 dtype、仅缓冲转 fp32，并打 warning。

#### 4.5.2 核心流程

```text
_post_init_method(module) 末尾:
    _keep_in_fp32(module)
        pattern = keep_in_fp32_pattern(module, 配置, 训练dtype)
          ├─ 训练dtype 是 fp32 → None（无需保留）
          ├─ "auto" → 收集 module.named_modules() 里各子模块的
          │   _keep_in_fp32_modules_strict (+fp16 时 _keep_in_fp32) 列表 → 编译正则
          └─ 显式列表 → 列表项做 glob(*→.*) → 编译正则
        若 pattern 为 None → 返回

        params_offloaded = (remote_device != local_device)
        keep_tensors_in_fp32(module, pattern, include_params=not params_offloaded)
          对每个匹配的浮点参数/缓冲:
            ├─ 分区带 ds_quant_scale → 告警 + 跳过（量化保持量化）
            ├─ 存储已是 fp32 → 跳过
            ├─ 有 ds_tensor → partition.data.float()
            │     └─ ds_secondary_tensor 存在且未量化 → 同步 .float()
            └─ tensor.data.float()（占位符/已 gather 的全量）
        params_offloaded → warning("parameters offloaded to ... stay <dtype>; only buffers ...")
```

下游联动（本讲只点出、详见 u5-l9）：stage3 优化器按分区 dtype 拆子组与梯度缓冲；`use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params` 下取回按 dtype 拆桶（4.3）；引擎在 ZeRO-0/1/2 或开参数卸载时把点名参数 cast 到训练 dtype——auto 模式 warning、显式列表 ValueError（[engine.py:L1938-L1947](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L1938-L1947)）；能力判定 `_keeps_params_in_fp32` 的依据是「只有 ZeRO-3 且无参数卸载才持有按 dtype 的分区缓冲」（[engine.py:L1927-L1936](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L1927-L1936)）。

```python
# practice_keep_fp32.py（示例代码）
import torch
import deepspeed

HIDDEN = 64
# 在 8.0 附近、bf16 分辨不开的一组值（bf16 在 8.0 处间隔 0.0625）
EXACT = 8.0 + torch.arange(HIDDEN, dtype=torch.float32) * 1e-4

class Toy(torch.nn.Module):
    _keep_in_fp32_modules_strict = ["sink", "router_bias"]
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = torch.nn.Linear(HIDDEN, HIDDEN, bias=False)
        self.sink = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.full((HIDDEN,), 8.0))
        self.register_buffer("router_bias", torch.zeros(HIDDEN))
    def forward(self, x):
        return ((self.linear(x) * self.sink + self.router_bias)**2).mean()

def config(keep):
    return {
        "train_micro_batch_size_per_gpu": 1,
        "optimizer": {"type": "Adam", "params": {"lr": 1e-3}},
        "zero_optimization": {"stage": 3, "stage3_param_persistence_threshold": 0},
        "bf16": {"enabled": True},
        "data_types": {"keep_in_fp32_modules": keep},
    }

for keep in ("auto", []):
    cfg = config(keep)
    with deepspeed.zero.Init(config_dict_or_path=cfg):
        model = Toy()
    # 模拟 transformers 的 ZeRO-3 检查点加载路径
    with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters([model.sink], modifier_rank=0):
        model.sink.data.copy_(EXACT)
    stored = model.sink.ds_tensor.dtype if hasattr(model.sink, "ds_tensor") else model.sink.dtype
    with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters([model.sink]):
        back = model.sink.data.detach().clone()
    print(f"keep={keep!r}: stored dtype={stored}, "
          f"exact存活={torch.equal(back.cpu(), EXACT)}, "
          f"全部塌缩为8.0={torch.equal(back.float().cpu(), torch.full((HIDDEN,), 8.0))}")
```

**需要观察的现象**：`keep="auto"` 时 `stored dtype=torch.float32`、`exact存活=True`；`keep=[]` 时 `stored dtype=torch.bfloat16`、`全部塌缩为8.0=True`——同一份写入值，两种命运。

#### 4.5.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `_keep_in_fp32` 放在 `_post_init_method`（每个模块都触发一次）末尾，而不是 `Init.__exit__` 里只做一次？

**答案**：`_post_init_method` 在 transformers 模型自身 `__init__` 刚结束时就拿到了完整的 fp32 列表（含嵌套子模块的），且此刻必须立刻转换——因为用户的下一行代码可能就是检查点加载（`GatheredParameters` + `copy_`），等 `with` 块退出再转就晚了：加载写入的 fp32 值会先被 bf16 分区舍入。放在每个模块的收尾处也天然覆盖了 `Init(module=...)` 的事后切分入口（[L1177](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1177)）。

**练习 2**：`keep_tensors_in_fp32` 对量化分区为什么「保持量化并告警」而不是报错？

**答案**：量化权重（`zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights`）的分区存的是 int8 码和缩放因子，`partition.data.float()` 得到的是码值不是权重值，转换毫无意义；但这些参数必然是冻结的（不可训练），它们的数值精度由量化本身决定、与 fp32 保留机制的目标（训练中分辨微小更新/差异）无关，因此降级为 warning 让训练继续（[keep_in_fp32.py:L98-L102](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L98-L102)）。

**练习 3**：参数卸载（`remote_device="cpu"`）时为什么参数不能保留 fp32？

**答案**：卸载分区的存储形态是「一块单一训练 dtype 的平坦 CPU/NVMe 缓冲」，没有为每个参数独立指定 dtype 的余地；混入 fp32 分区会破坏缓冲布局。所以 `Init._keep_in_fp32` 检测 `remote_device != local_device` 后传 `include_params=False` 只转 buffers，并告警一次（[partition_parameters.py:L1260-L1267](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1260-L1267)）。引擎侧的判定同理（[engine.py:L1927-L1936](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L1927-L1936)）。

## 5. 综合实践

把本讲四个模块串成一条链：**构造期切分 → 观察布局 → 取回验证 → keep_in_fp32 精度实验**。

任务：写一个脚本 `u5l2_lab.py`，用一个两层 Transformer（`nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=64, nhead=4, dim_feedforward=128)` × 2）完成三组实验：

1. **布局审计**（4.1/4.2）：在 `zero.Init(config_dict_or_path=...)`（bf16、stage 3、`stage3_param_persistence_threshold=0`）内构造模型，逐参数打印 `ds_numel`、`ds_numel_aligned`、`ds_tensor.numel()`、`ds_tensor.dtype`、`ds_tensor.numel() / ds_numel_aligned`（占空比），并汇总验证 `sum(各参数 aligned) == sum(各参数 ds_tensor.numel()) × world_size`（每 rank 各自核对）。
2. **往返验证**（4.3）：构造前保存一份权重初值，`GatheredParameters` 内 gather 全部参数、逐参数比对（bf16 舍入下的最大相对误差），退出后确认回到 `[0]` 占位。
3. **精度实验**（4.5）：给模型挂 `_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict = ["in_proj_bias"]`（或任选一个真实存在的参数名，用 `dict(model.named_parameters())` 先确认名字），重复 keep="auto"/[] 两轮，对比该参数的 `ds_tensor.dtype` 与写入 `EXACT_VALUES` 后的存活情况（照搬 4.5.4 的判定代码）。

进阶（可选）：把 world_size 从 1 调到 2，观察哪些数字变了（padding 出现、all-gather 路径从 NoGather 变为真通信）；打开 `stage3_use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params=true` 并给模型制造一个 fp32 参数（keep_in_fp32），在日志级别 DEBUG 下观察取回拆成两次 flat all-reduce（源码路径 [L1450-L1460](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1450-L1460)，运行现象待本地验证）。

预期产出：一张参数布局表 + 一段往返误差统计 + keep_in_fp32 两种配置的对照输出。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `zero.Init` 通过 patch `torch.nn.Module.__init__`，让每个子模块在**构造完成的瞬间**就被切分（`_post_init_method`：搬设备 → rank 0 广播对齐初值 → `partition()`），把「先装下完整 fp32 模型」的构造期显存墙拆掉。
- 切分规则是纯算术：padding 补齐到 world size 的倍数（\(\(P = (W - N \bmod W) \bmod W\)\)），等长分桶，rank \(r\) 拿 \([rS, (r+1)S)\)；小于 `stage3_param_persistence_threshold` 的参数可豁免切分常驻本卡；切分后 `param.data` 变 0 元素占位符。
- 取回靠句柄家族：默认 all-gather 合并取回（按通信 dtype 分桶、flat 缓冲 narrow 拼回），`stage3_use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params` 走 all-reduce 换通信量，world_size=1 时 NoGather 零通信；#8843 之后多 dtype 分区必须按 dtype 拆桶、每 dtype 一次 flat 通信（`MultipleAllGatherHandles` 打包）。
- `register_external_parameter` 为「不在宿主 forward 里使用」的权重补上 gather/release 的挂钩，是跨模块权重共享和 glm_moe_dsa 这类自定义注意力的必备配套。
- #8843 给 `Init` 加了收尾钩子 `_keep_in_fp32`：在每个模块 `__init__` 跑完、检查点加载之前，把 transformers 点名的参数/缓冲**就地转回 fp32**——参数直接转 `ds_tensor` 分区（hpZ 二级副本同步），量化分区保持量化告警，参数卸载只保 buffers 并告警；由此 gather 返回 fp32、检查点值精确存活，下游的 stage3 混合 dtype 支撑在 u5-l9 展开。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- **下一讲 u5-l3（ZeRO-1/2）**：看梯度方向的对应机制——IPG bucket、reduce-scatter 与平坦梯度缓冲，与本讲的参数切分互为镜像。

- **延伸阅读**：官方文档 [docs/_pages/zero.md](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/docs/_pages/zero.md) 的 "Constructing Massive Models" 一节；`GatheredParameters` 的完整 docstring（[partition_parameters.py:L2292-L2366](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L2292-L2366)）里还有从 ZeRO-3 检查点手工加载权重的范例。

1. 解释 `deepspeed.zero.Init` 上下文管理器如何在模型**构建期**（而不是训练开始后）就把每个参数切分到多个进程上，以及为什么这能突破「单卡必须先装下完整 fp32 模型」的显存墙。

4. 说明 `register_external_parameter` 解决什么问题：不在宿主模块 `forward()` 里使用的权重，靠谁来触发 gather 与释放。
5. 解读本周期 #8843 给 `zero.Init` 增加的收尾钩子 `_keep_in_fp32`：transformers 模型点名的 fp32 参数/缓冲如何在**分区上**就地转回 fp32，量化分区为何保持量化，参数卸载时为何只保 buffers。

本讲是 ZeRO 单元（u5）的第二篇，承接 u5-l1 的三阶段显存公式，把 stage 3 的「参数切分」从概念落到源码。

## 2. 前置知识

- **ZeRO-3 参数切分（u5-l1）**：混合精度 + Adam 下每卡模型状态约 \(16\Psi\) 字节，stage 3 把参数本身也按数据并行度切分，每卡只留 \(1/N_d\)。本讲解释这个切分发生在什么时刻、按什么规则。
- **torch.nn.Module 的构造协议**：PyTorch 模型是嵌套的 `nn.Module`，每个子模块在自己的 `__init__` 里创建 `nn.Parameter`。`zero.Init` 的核心技巧就是在「每个子模块 `__init__` 刚结束」这个时刻插一脚。
- **上下文管理器**：`with ... :` 语法进入 `__enter__`、离开 `__exit__`。`zero.Init()` 本身是一个可以 `with` 的对象。
- **分布式进程组（u3-l2/u3-l3）**：`dist.get_rank()`、`dist.get_world_size()`、all-gather/all-reduce 等集合通信的原语语义；`deepspeed.comm` 是对 torch.distributed 的统一包装。
- **bf16 的分辨率问题（u4-l3）**：bf16 只有 8 位尾数，数值 8.0 附近的相邻可表示值相差 0.0625；某些张量（如 MoE 路由 bias `e_score_correction_bias`）的取值在 bf16 下会塌缩成同一个值，这是 #8843 整套 keep_in_fp32 机制的动机。
- **检查点加载时机**：transformers 的 `from_pretrained` 在模型 `__init__` 跑完之后才把权重拷进去；这个顺序是理解「收尾钩子为什么放在 `_post_init_method` 末尾」的关键。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 Init 上下文管理器：给 nn.Module 注入「出生即切分」钩子

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

普通方式训练 ZeRO-3 有一个隐藏前提：模型必须**先被完整构造出来**（每卡一份完整的 fp32 参数），然后引擎才能把它切分。对一个万亿参数模型，fp32 权重是 4TB——每张卡、每个进程都要先在 CPU 内存里装下这 4TB，构造完成才能释放。这堵墙与训练时的稳态显存无关，纯粹是「出生时刻」的瞬时峰值。

`zero.Init` 的解法是把切分时机提前到构造期：在每个 `nn.Module.__init__` 结束的瞬间，立刻把它刚创建的参数切分、丢掉全量副本。这样任意时刻每张卡最多只持有「正在构造的那一层」的全量参数，构造完成即释放。官方 docstring 用万亿参数模型算了这笔账：8 卡节点本来需要 32TB CPU 内存（数据并行冗余），切分后无论多少卡都只需要原样的 4TB。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
with deepspeed.zero.Init():
    model = MyLargeModel()
    │
    ├─ __enter__: patch torch.nn.Module.__init__（在每个子模块 __init__ 末尾追加 _post_init_method）
    │             zero_init_context 深度计数 +1（支持嵌套 with）
    │
    ├─ MyLargeModel() 内部：每个子模块 __init__ 结束时触发 _post_init_method(module)
    │    ├─ 遍历 module.named_parameters(recurse=False)（只看本模块直属参数）
    │    ├─ param 搬到本卡 → 广播对齐各 rank 的初始值 → param.partition() 切分
    │    └─ self._keep_in_fp32(module)   ← #8843 新增收尾钩子（见 4.5）
    │
    └─ __exit__: 恢复被 patch 的 __init__，打印参数统计
```

要点：子模块是**从内向外**逐层构造的——`Linear` 先于 `TransformerLayer`、`TransformerLayer` 先于整个 model——所以 `_post_init_method` 会在每层构造完的瞬间就切掉它，父模块后续对这些权重的修改则由包装过的 `Module.apply` 走「先 gather 再改再 partition」的路径保证不丢失。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

基类 `InsertPostInitMethodToModuleSubClasses` 负责进出上下文时安装/卸载补丁，用模块级计数器 `zero_init_context` 支持嵌套，并在顶层上下文退出时打印参数统计：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L353-L386](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L353-L386)：`__enter__` 里只有 `zero_init_context == 0`（最外层）才真正 `patch_init_and_builtins()`；`__exit__` 把计数减一，归零时卸载补丁并让 rank 0 打印 `finished initializing model - num_params = ...`。

`Init` 类继承它，构造函数先解析配置并读取 keep_in_fp32 设置：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L946-L953](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L946-L953)：`class Init(InsertPostInitMethodToModuleSubClasses)`，类属性里还有 `param_persistence_threshold` 等持久化阈值（见 4.2）。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1079-L1083](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1079-L1083)：从 `DeepSpeedConfig` 读出 `keep_in_fp32_modules`（`data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules`，默认 `"auto"`）；若未初始化分布式则顺带 `init_distributed()`。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1131-L1135](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1131-L1135)：`local_device` 由 `LOCAL_RANK` 环境变量决定。注意：**当前版本没有 `gpu_id` 参数**（旧版教程里的 `gpu_id` 已移除），设备选择完全走 `LOCAL_RANK`。

`_post_init_method` 是整个机制的心脏：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1227-L1248](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1227-L1248)：遍历**直属**参数（`recurse=False`，因为子模块早已各自处理过），跳过已是 zero param 的；不在加速器上的先搬到本卡；名字为 `weight` 且配置了量化初始化的先量化；然后 `_zero_init_param` 完成切分。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1195-L1202](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1195-L1202)：`_zero_init_param` 三步——转成 deepspeed 参数（挂上 `ds_tensor` 等属性）、在分区组内从 rank 0 **广播**初始值（否则各 rank 各自随机初始化，切出的分片拼起来就不是同一个模型）、最后 `param.partition()`。

除了 `with` 语法，`Init` 还提供「事后切分」入口，用于已经构造好的 CPU 模型：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1173-L1177](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1173-L1177)：传入 `module=` 时走 `_convert_to_zero_parameters`（注意这条路没有广播步骤，要求各 rank 模型一致），随后同样调用 `_keep_in_fp32(module)`——两个入口共享收尾钩子。

`free_param` 解释了「切分后参数本体去哪了」——`param.data` 被替换成一个 0 元素占位张量，真实数据只在 `ds_tensor` 分区里：

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L308-L325](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L308-L325)：`param.data = torch.empty(0, dtype=param.dtype, device=param.device)`，状态置为 `NOT_AVAILABLE`。这就是为什么 ZeRO-3 下直接读 `param.data` 会得到空张量、必须经 `GatheredParameters` 或 hook 触发的 all-gather 取回。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：亲眼确认「参数出生即切分」——构造完的模型里，`param.data` 是 0 元素占位符，真实数据躺在 `param.ds_tensor` 里。

**操作步骤**（单进程即可，CPU 环境可跑）：

```python
import torch
import deepspeed

with deepspeed.zero.Init(dtype=torch.bfloat16):
    linear = torch.nn.Linear(1000, 1000)

w = linear.weight
print("ds_status:", w.ds_status)          # NOT_AVAILABLE：已切分、未取回
print("data.shape:", w.data.shape)        # torch.Size([0])：占位符
print("ds_tensor:", w.ds_tensor)          # 本 rank 持有的分区
print("ds_numel:", w.ds_numel)            # 原始元素数 1000000
print("ds_numel_aligned:", w.ds_numel_aligned)
print("partition numel:", w.ds_tensor.ds_numel)
```

运行：`torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 practice_zero_init_basic.py`（若缺 GPU 用 `deepspeed --num_cpus 1` 或设置 DS_ACCELERATOR=cpu，待本地验证）。

**需要观察的现象**：`data.shape` 为 `[0]`；`ds_tensor.ds_numel` 等于 `ds_numel_aligned`（world_size=1 时二者都等于 1000000，padding 为 0）。

**预期结果**：world_size=1 时一切数值都相等——这恰好说明单进程下切分是「恒等」的，也解释了 4.3 的 NoGather 优化为什么存在。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `_post_init_method` 里遍历参数用 `recurse=False`？

**答案**：子模块构造完成时它的参数已被切分并挂上 `ds_tensor`（变成 zero param），父模块的 `_post_init_method` 只需处理自己新建的直属参数；递归遍历只会重复处理已切分参数（代码里也用 `is_zero_param(param)` 跳过，但 `recurse=False` 从根上避免了）。

**练习 2**：`_zero_init_param` 为什么在 partition 之前先 broadcast？

**答案**：`nn.Linear` 等层的默认初始化是随机采样，各进程种子不同则各 rank 拿到的「完整模型」不同；先在分区组内从 rank 0 广播，保证所有 rank 从同一份初值切分，切出来的分片才能拼回同一个模型。

**练习 3**：`with zero.Init():` 里再嵌套一层 `with zero.Init():` 会重复 patch 吗？

**答案**：不会。`zero_init_context` 计数器保证只有最外层（计数从 0 变 1）执行 `patch_init_and_builtins`，内层只加计数；退出时计数归零才卸载，见 [partition_parameters.py:L353-L376](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L353-L376)。

### 4.2 partition：对齐、分桶与就地切分

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

「把参数切给 W 个 rank」需要先回答一个除法问题：\(N\) 个元素分给 \(W\) 份，除不尽怎么办？答案是 padding：补零凑成 \(W\) 的倍数，再等分。同时，并非所有参数都值得切分——小于阈值的参数（比如 norm 的 scale/bias）保持复制（persist）反而省通信。

需要澄清一个历史名词：旧版 DeepSpeed 教材里的 `max_num_params`（限制单次 all-gather 的参数量）在当前代码中已不存在；与之配套的 bucket 控制现在由 stage3 优化器侧的 `stage3_prefetch_bucket_size`、`reduce_bucket_size` 等配置承担（见 [zero/config.py:L113-L255](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/config.py#L113-L255)，详解在 u5-l6）。`Init` 层面的切分只由 world size 和持久化阈值决定。另外注意：配置项 `parameter_alignment`（[zero/config.py:L327](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/config.py#L327)）属于 ZeRO-1/2 的扁平缓冲对齐（stage_1_and_2.py），与本讲的按 world size 对齐是两回事。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

设参数元素数为 \(N\)（`ds_numel`），分区组大小为 \(W\)，则：

\[
P = (W - N \bmod W) \bmod W \quad\text{（padding）}
\]

\[
A = N + P \quad\text{（aligned\_size）}, \qquad S = \frac{A}{W} \quad\text{（每 rank 分区大小）}
\]

rank \(r\) 负责原参数展平后的区间 \([rS,\ (r+1)S)\)，区间尾巴越过 \(N\) 的部分不拷贝（保持新分配的空值）。因此**所有 rank 的分区拼起来是 \(A\) 个元素 ≥ \(N\)**，多出来的就是 padding。

流程伪代码：

```text
partition(param):
    若 ds_tensor 已存在且未被更新 → 只释放 param.data（重复 partition 幂等）
    A = ds_numel + padding_size
    S = A // world_size
    分配 partitioned_tensor（remote_device 上，S 个元素，dtype=param.dtype）
      ├─ ds_persist 且很小 → 留在本卡
      ├─ remote_device=nvme → 从 swapper 拿缓冲
      ├─ 不可训练且开 zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights → 存 int8 码 + ds_quant_scale
      └─ cpu 且 pin_memory → 锁页
    把 one_dim_param 的 [rS, min((r+1)S, N)) 拷进本 rank 分区
    free_param(param)  # param.data 变 0 元素占位符
```

- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1701-L1710](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1701-L1710)：对齐三件套 `_aligned_size` / `_padding_size` / `_partition_numel`，就是上面两个公式的直译。
- [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py:L1785-L1844](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1785-L1844)：`_partition_param` 的分配段——`tensor_size = self._aligned_size(param)`、`partition_size = tensor_size // self._partition_world_size(param)`；随后按 remote_device/persist/量化三种情况分配分区张量，并记录 `ds_numel_aligned`。
